name: Takao Ibuki
source:
A botany student at Kaibara University who is a cat lover and wishes to have a catgirl. His devotion and care for cats doesn't go unnoticed and so it catches the attention of the [url=https://vndb.org/c56436]Cat God[/url]. And so as a reward Cat God gifts Ibuki a catgirl therefore fulfilling his wish. But this catgirl comes with complications. A mishap in her transport from the Cat Kingdom allowed a few extra travelers to jump over to the human world. With no other place to go, these extra girls have no choice but to congregate around his humble abode.  And now the group must come together as one big happy family and wait for the time when they can return to their own world.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/919344-lets-meow-meow/faqs/35340]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
